# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC32 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

## Scope

RC32 adds a keyboard recent-commit picker so commit history can be filtered and inspected without copying hashes by hand on the iPad/Blink route.

- `Esc v L` opens a `GIT COMMITS` picker.
- `:commits`, `:commit-picker`, `:git-commits`, and `:open-commit` open the same picker.
- The picker snapshots one bounded recent-log read and filters the retained labels locally as the user types.
- Labels show the newest 100 decorated commits using the same ordering as the read-only Git Log view.
- Enter opens the selected commit as a read-only Git Commit details view.
- An unborn repository reports `No commits yet` without opening an empty prompt.
- The command does not stage, save, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the recent-commit picker route.
